donor-receipts: This is Riverbend Community Food Bank, a fictional demo. Donor receipts and stewardship: the agent finds gifts that still need a receipt number. The summary lists gifts without a receipt number, and donors with no gift in the last year. Here, Sam Rivera's donor record has no mailing address, so a receipt can't be issued yet. Staff add the address on the donor record. Numbers are set in order, and a person issues each receipt. Demo data is fictional. Nothing is sent.
volunteers: Volunteer coordination, in a fictional demo. The agent checks whether each shift has enough cleared volunteers. The summary shows shifts that need screened volunteers, and youth and driving roles need screening cleared first. Records: one driver has cleared screening, and the Saturday delivery shift needs three. Demo data is fictional. Nothing is sent.
grants: Grant tracking and reporting, in a fictional demo. The agent keeps a funder calendar with deadlines, and drafts application sections and progress reports from the results staff enter. Staff enter the funder's deadline, the amount requested, and the status. Demo data is fictional. Nothing is sent.
newsletter: Newsletter and communications, in a fictional demo. The agent drafts newsletters and social posts from your updates, and sends only to subscribers who have consented, with an unsubscribe line. Staff record each subscriber's consent and where it came from. Demo data is fictional. Nothing is sent.
governance: Board and governance, in a fictional demo. The agent drafts agendas and minutes from meeting notes. Minutes record only the motions in the notes, and the board approves them. Staff enter the meeting title, date, type, agenda, and notes. Demo data is fictional. Nothing is sent.
compliance: Compliance calendar, in a fictional demo. The agent tracks the deadlines the organization enters, shows what is overdue, and drafts reminders. The app does not know government deadlines. Staff enter each date from an official source. Demo data is fictional. Nothing is sent.
renewals: Membership renewals, in a fictional demo. The agent shows who is renewing soon and who has lapsed, and drafts reminders only for members who agreed to receive email. Staff enter each member's name, membership type, and paid-until date. Demo data is fictional. Nothing is sent.
events: Events and engagement, in a fictional demo. Paste a newsletter's events or add them by hand. An approver confirms each event before drafts are made. Staff enter the event name and date, and the other details are optional. Demo data is fictional. Nothing is sent.
